text:
sara: Quick sync  iterating on the Alerting -> Threshold row + notification preview. Focus: clearer copy for what 'preview' does, keyboard flow, and small contrast fixes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/alerts-slo (frame: simulate-preview). Please drop quick hits.

maya: Two copy ideas: primary CTA could be 'Simulate notification' vs 'Send test notification'  leaning to 'Simulate' because it implies non-persistence. But button microcopy should avoid parentheses.

oliver: UX: show the simulated payload summary (first 200 chars) in the preview so engineers can validate config without leaving the modal. Keep it collapsed by default.

kevin: Accessibility note: contrast for the tiny helper text under the threshold row is currently 3.5:1 on our palette. We should bump it to 4.5:1 or use a slightly darker gray.

a11y-bot: Screen reader guidance: announce the preview open/close and the result of a simulation. Suggested live region string: "Simulation complete: 2 channels notified, 1 failed (simulated)". Use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true".

maya: Keyboard flow bug found: when the modal opens focus lands on the close X, but visually the primary action is 'Simulate' top-left in the modal. Let's move initial focus to the primary action to reduce tabbing friction. Also ensure Esc restores focus to the threshold toggle.

oliver: For the channel pill list, add an aria-label like "Select channel to test" and make pills keyboard-togglable with space/enter. Pills should have focus visible outline (2px) and not rely on color alone.

kevin: Copy tweak for threshold line: replace 'Incident if > 5% errors' with 'Trigger when request error rate > 5% over a 5-minute rolling window'. Explicit window helps reduce support questions.

maya: Agree. Also adding a tiny tooltip icon next to the time window that opens short explainer: "We evaluate errors with a rolling window; the duration is configurable." Tooltip max width 280px.

design-bot: Suggested microcopy rules in this thread: sentence case, avoid parentheses in CTA, prefer active verbs (Simulate, Trigger, Retry), include unit/time ("5 minutes"), and localize time/timestamps.

oliver: Edge case: when a simulated send hits a throttling response from a channel (429), show inline status on that channel pill with a small warning icon and a contextual 'why?' tooltip that links to docs. Do not surface the 429 as a global banner.

maya: I'll mock inline states: success (green dot), partial fail (yellow, with retry), fail (red, with error code). Add aria-describedby on pill to point to human message e.g., "Webhook 500: server error (simulated)".

a11y-bot: For localization, avoid hard-coded counts in live region strings. Use templates such as "Simulation complete: {successCount} channels, {failCount} failed (simulated)" to allow pluralization rules. Also avoid punctuation that confuses some screen readers (no parentheses).

kevin: Color polish: increase focus ring contrast and keep the token background for pills at least 3:1 contrast with page bg.

oliver: One tiny nit on mobile: the preview modal currently covers the entire screen and hides the threshold context. Suggest a bottom sheet on mobile that keeps a small header visible so the user can confirm the threshold they simulated.

maya: Great call. I'll iterate on desktop modal -> primary focus 'Simulate notification', include payload preview collapsed, inline channel statuses, tooltip copy, and update contrast tokens. Will push an updated fig and a short PR with aria-live string + keyboard focus adjustments.

sara: @a11y-bot can you run quick smoke tests on mac+voiceover and windows+nvda after the PR? Post results here.

a11y-bot: Will do  will report back with any focus order or announcement mismatches.

maya: Thanks all  aiming to ship these small polish fixes this sprint. If anyone wants to pair on the aria implementation I'm free after 3pm. :rocket:
